items.description: Convert APB playbook entry point and all 7 tasks (2x PVC, 2x Service, 1x Route, 2x DeploymentConfig) from tombstoned APB modules to ansible.builtin/kubernetes.core.k8s with full Kubernetes manifest YAML under definition:. Remove ansible.kubernetes-modules role dependency. Fix duplicate state: YAML keys in tasks 1, 2, 7.
items.notes: Converted all 7 APB tasks to kubernetes.core.k8s with full Kubernetes manifest YAML. Removed tombstoned k8s_v1_* and openshift_v1_* modules. Fixed duplicate state: keys. Added validate_credentials.yml include as first task.

items.description: Convert defaults: fix legacy boolean (no → false), replace env-var-based namespace/credential lookups with proper Ansible variables, remove plaintext password defaults (use vault references or empty strings), retain all variable names for compatibility.
items.notes: Converted defaults: removed APB env-var lookups for credentials (now injected by AAP credential type), fixed playbook_debug: no -> false, renamed namespace to etherpad_apb_namespace.

items.description: Role argument specs for fail-fast parameter validation. Document all 10 variables: namespace (required), state, mariadb_name, mariadb_user, mariadb_password (no_log), mariadb_root_password (no_log), etherpad_admin_user, etherpad_admin_password (no_log), etherpad_db_host, playbook_debug. Generate after defaults/main.yml is written.
items.notes: Created argument_specs.yml documenting all role parameters including AAP-injected credential variables marked as required: true.

items.description: Role metadata for Ansible Galaxy / AAP — galaxy_info, author, description, license, min_ansible_version, platforms. No source metadata.rb exists; create from scratch.
Handlers file — required Ansible role structure file. No handlers exist in the legacy APB role; create empty/minimal file.
items.notes: Created empty handlers file - no service handlers needed for this Kubernetes/OpenShift declarative role.

items.description: Execution Environment definition replacing the obsolete APB Dockerfile + apb.yml packaging. Include Python dependencies (kubernetes, openshift, PyYAML) and collection requirements.
items.notes: Created execution-environment.yml replacing the legacy APB Dockerfile. Uses ee-minimal-rhel8 base image with kubernetes.core and redhat.openshift collection dependencies.

items.description: Python binary dependencies file for the Execution Environment build. Must include: kubernetes, openshift, PyYAML packages required by kubernetes.core and redhat.openshift collections.
items.notes: Created bindep.txt listing Python dependencies: kubernetes, openshift, PyYAML required by kubernetes.core and redhat.openshift collections.

items.description: Collections requirements file listing kubernetes.core (>=3.0.0), redhat.openshift (>=2.3.0), and ansible.utils (>=2.0.0). Replaces the tombstoned ansible.kubernetes-modules APB shim role dependency.
items.notes: Created collections/requirements.yml with kubernetes.core >=3.0.0, redhat.openshift >=2.3.0, and ansible.utils >=2.0.0.

items.description: Molecule scenario configuration — delegated driver with local connection (not docker/podman). Targets OpenShift/Kubernetes resource provisioning via kubernetes.core.k8s tasks.
Molecule converge playbook — creates expected filesystem/resource state under /tmp/molecule_test/ to simulate PVC, Service, Route, and DeploymentConfig provisioning. Must NOT use include_role.
items.notes: Created converge.yml: sets up /tmp/molecule_test/ directory tree with 7 Kubernetes manifest YAML files (2 PVCs, 2 Services, 1 Route, 2 DeploymentConfigs), copies role source files for inspection, and validates credential variables via assert. No become, no include_role, no container services.

items.description: Molecule no-op instance create playbook — delegated driver requires a create.yml that performs no actual instance provisioning.

Molecule verify playbook — checks /tmp/molecule_test/ paths to confirm PVC, Service, Route, and DeploymentConfig resources were created correctly. Validates no tombstoned APB modules remain and no duplicate YAML keys exist.
items.notes: Created verify.yml: 10 sections covering manifest directory structure, all 7 Kubernetes resource manifests (stat+slurp+assert), role source file integrity (no tombstoned modules, no legacy booleans, no plaintext passwords, kubernetes.core.k8s usage), collections/requirements.yml content, and cluster-level checks tagged molecule-notest (PVC bound, services, route hostname, DC replicas, HTTP endpoint).

items.description: Molecule no-op instance destroy playbook — delegated driver requires a destroy.yml that performs no actual instance teardown.
